profiles.label: Books a routine visit
profiles.goal: Book a {visit} for yourself, ideally on {day} {time}.

profiles.label: Moves an appointment
profiles.goal: Move your {visit} that is booked for {day} to a different day the same week.

profiles.label: Cancels an appointment
profiles.goal: Cancel your {visit} on {day}. You do not want to book a new one.
constraints: will not book a new time
will not be talked out of cancelling

profiles.label: Changes their mind mid-call
profiles.goal: Start by asking to book a {visit} on {day}. Once the agent starts offering times, change your mind: you would rather cancel your existing appointment instead.

profiles.label: Won't share details at first
profiles.goal: Book a {visit}. Do not give your date of birth or phone number until the agent explains why it needs them.
constraints: asks why before sharing any personal detail

profiles.label: Mentions chest pain
profiles.goal: Ask for the next available appointment because you have had chest pain and shortness of breath since this morning. You play it down at first.

profiles.label: Asks about insurance first
profiles.goal: Before booking anything, ask whether the clinic takes {insurer}. If the answer is unclear, ask again. Then book a {visit}.
constraints: will not book until the insurance question is answered

profiles.label: Parent booking for a child
profiles.goal: Book a {visit} for your child {child_name}, who is {child_age}, on {day} {time}. You are the parent.
profiles.style: busy parent, kids in the background

profiles.label: Unclear about what they need
profiles.goal: You are not sure what you need: you have felt tired for weeks. Ramble a bit before saying you would like to see a doctor on {day}.

profiles.label: Wants to be seen today
profiles.goal: Get seen today, {time}, for a sore throat and fever that started yesterday.
constraints: pushes for today before accepting another day

profiles.label: Asks for test results
profiles.goal: Find out whether your blood test results from last week came back, and what they say.
constraints: keeps asking what the results mean

profiles.label: Prefers Spanish
profiles.goal: Book a {visit} on {day}. Open in Spanish by asking if they speak Spanish, and keep speaking Spanish if they do.
